pages.text: As your Soul Energy continues to grow, you have noticed that elite units have begun appearing among the hunting illagers. These new high-ranking Illagers, belonging to some royal court or high council, are well-equipped and well-trained. You believe it is necessary to record their existence as a reminder to yourself.
Members of the royal forces wielding greatswords. They can easily lift weapons far too heavy for ordinary folk, and their weapons restore some of their health upon striking creatures.

Illagers trained to be surprisingly skilled hunters, held in high esteem among their kind. They often carry a bounty list, using their superb marksmanship and explosive ammunition to hunt down the prey on it one by one. Unfortunately, they are only interested in dangerous threats like you.
